{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && mkdir -p specs/001-transactions/checklists && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json
checklist = """# Specification Quality Checklist: Tagged Cache (TaggedCache)

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous
- [x] Success criteria are measurable
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined
- [x] Edge cases are identified
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification

## Notes

- Validation run 2026-10-17 against spec.md (216 lines):
  - `grep -c 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' spec.md` -> 0 (pass; the single open
    item, Claim-A variant put_no_recency_refresh, is recorded as an
    Assumption/extension for the clarify phase, not a blocker).
  - All mandatory sections present: User Scenarios & Testing, Requirements
    (Functional + Key Entities), Success Criteria, Assumptions.
  - "No implementation details": spec names the public type/method names
    (`TaggedCache`, `put`, `get`, `invalidate`, `maxsize`) and one module
    path because the issue text fixes them as the required public surface;
    no language-internal design (data structures, algorithms) is specified.
    Treated as contract naming, not implementation detail (pass with note).
  - Success criteria reference the public acceptance suite and test
    coverage as verification vehicles; the underlying outcomes (no
    regressions, exact counts, stable state on invalid input) are
    behavior-level (pass with note).
- Items marked incomplete would require spec updates before
  `$speckit-plan`; none are incomplete. One carried-forward open item:
  Claim-A candidate extension (put recency refresh on overwrite) to be
  resolved in clarify/plan.
"""
open("specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md","w").write(checklist)
json.dump({"feature_directory": "specs/001-transactions"}, open(".specify/feature.json","w"), indent=2)
print("checklist + feature.json written")
PYEOF
echo === VALIDATION ===
grep -c 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' specs/001-transactions/spec.md; grep -n '^## ' specs/001-transactions/spec.md; cat .specify/feature.json"}
